claims.text: PlanError stores a code attribute and forwards the message to Exception via super().__init__.

decision.rule: Change here when the plan subsystem error contract (code or message) needs to change.
decision.failure: A plan failure is raised without a code, or the message is lost instead of reaching str(exc).

questions.q: Where is the plan error type defined and what does it store?
Where should I change how PlanError carries its code to callers?
Where can I debug a plan error with an empty message?
